physics-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-04.material: Bola tesi horizontálmente husi ninin foho ho aas $20\,\mathrm{m}$ no monu ba rai iha okos foho iha distánsia horizontál $30\,\mathrm{m}$ husi foho. Bainhira $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ no ignora rezisténsia ar, pár saida mak loos hatudu velosidade bola iha momentu kontaktu ho rai no $\tan\theta$ husi ángulu $\theta$ nebé direksaun velosidade halo ho horizontál, tuir sekuénsia?
physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Xoke no Seguransa, Projesaun Orizontál no Gravidade
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Bola tesi horizontálmente husi ninin foho ho aas $20\,\mathrm{m}$ no monu ba rai iha okos foho iha distánsia horizontál $30\,\mathrm{m}$ husi foho. Bainhira $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ no ignora rezisténsia ar, pár saida mak loos hatudu velosidade bola iha momentu kontaktu ho rai no $\tan\theta$ husi ángulu $\theta$ nebé direksaun velosidade halo ho horizontál, tuir sekuénsia?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Direksaun vertikál $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Direksaun horizontál $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Imediatamente molok monu $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Se soma velosidade nu’udar $v_0+gt=35$, mak resposta sala ①; se hakerek $\tan\theta$ ba kotuk, hetan $\frac34$ (resposta sala ②); se uza de’it komponente vertikál $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ nu’udar velosidade, mak resposta sala ④.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-04.s.s1.hint.0: Horizontál: $x=v_0t$, vertikál: $y=\frac12gt^2$. Husi tempu kuda hetan $v_0$, no velosidade bainhira monu mak $v=\sqrt{v_0^2+(gt)^2}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}$.
